title: Model Pairing for DPO Signal Quality
question: Do cross-model DPO pairs (pi-qwen-32b vs. qwen2.5-coder-14b) produce sharper preference signal than same-model temperature-varied pairs from Exp A?
hypothesis: Cross-model pairs on coding tasks have mean score_delta >= 1.5x the mean score_delta from same-model temperature rollouts on the same tasks.
falsified_if: Cross-model mean_delta < 1.2x same-model mean_delta, OR cross-model pairs fail build_dpo_dataset.py --min-delta 1.0 filter at rate >= 40% (i.e., models too similar to generate training signal).

decision_rule.use_cross_model_pairing: cross_delta / temp_delta >= 1.5 AND pass_rate(min_delta=1.0) >= 70% — cross-model pairs are worth the inference cost
decision_rule.use_temperature_variation: cross_delta / temp_delta < 1.2 — models produce similar outputs; temperature variation is cheaper and sufficient
decision_rule.use_both: cross_delta / temp_delta in [1.2, 1.5] — combine both sources; filter by delta >= 1.0 to deduplicate

method.spec_format: ExperimentSpec — factor is producer_model with 2 levels

tasks.note: coding tasks defined in tasks/rl_bank.jsonl (task_type=coding); research tasks are rl_bank rows 3,12,5,9,14 (0-indexed)

env.note: Score-only evaluation to preserve variance; same as Exp A --score-only

method.runner_note: experiment_runner.py calls agent.py as subprocess with env-var override; 10 tasks × 2 levels × 2 reps = 40 runs

post_collection.note: --cross-model removes the same-producer filter in build_cross_run_pairs(), pairing pi vs coder outputs on the same task

analysis.baseline: grpo.jsonl from Exp A — extract same 10 tasks, compute same-model temp delta
outputs: cross_vs_temp_delta_comparison.json — mean/median delta by source and task_type
dpo_pass_rate.json — fraction of cross-model pairs passing min_delta thresholds 0.5, 1.0, 1.5
score_distribution_by_model.json — score distributions per model per task
recommendation.json — final decision based on decision_rule above

controlled.tasks: 5 coding + 5 research — same prompts for both model levels

requires: build_dpo_dataset.py: --cross-model flag to allow cross-producer pairs
tasks/rl_bank.jsonl: 5 coding tasks added with task_type=coding
